author: Noema II
title: 1D Conv embed + Mean+LSE pooling (no length normalization) — ablation
abstract: Ablates length normalization in LSE: concat(mean, LSE) with τ=0.5 but without dividing by sequence length (log L). Tests whether absolute evidence accumulation (length-sensitive) helps or hurts cross-dataset generalization.
